title: DailyPlaytimeCap
description: A server-side Minecraft mod that lets moderators set daily playtime limits for players. (Fabric)
body:
# DailyPlaytimeCap

### NOTE: Fabric API is required
A server-side Minecraft mod that lets administrators set daily playtime limits for players.

## Features
- Set a player's daily playtime limit
- Check remaining time
- Remove a limit
- Automatically kicks players when their time runs out (they can't log back in for the day)
- Add extra time for a player for that day

## Usage
- `/dailyplaytime set <player> <minutes>` (mod perms required) 
- `/dailyplaytime check [player]` (mod perms required to check other players; users can check their own time remaining)
- `/dailyplaytime remove <player>` (mod perms required)
- `/dailyplaytime add_extra_time <player> <minutes>` (mod perms required)
